# SHA-256 checksums of third-party archives, pinned by hand.
#
# Format:  <file-name>  <sha256>
#
# scripts/fetch_third_party.sh REFUSES to install an archive absent from
# this file. On the first download it prints the computed checksum and
# the official URL to verify it against; it's up to you to compare it,
# once, then add the line here. No value is pre-filled: a checksum
# nobody verified protects nothing, it only gives the illusion of doing
# so.
#
# Verification sources:
#   libsodium  https://download.libsodium.org/libsodium/releases/
#              (minisign signatures, public key on libsodium.org)
#   sqlite     https://www.sqlite.org/download.html
#   imgui      https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/releases
#
# Example once filled in:
#   libsodium-1.0.20.tar.gz  <64 hex characters>

imgui-v1.91.5.tar.gz  2aa2d169c569368439e5d5667e0796d09ca5cc6432965ce082e516937d7db254
libsodium-1.0.20-stable-msvc.zip  ebaa204fdfcedc51dc1ee1bbd03c8d552a14b3372f87f94e44c71a8533f77df4
sqlite-amalgamation-3470000.zip  2842fddbb1cc33f66c7da998a57535f14a6bfee159676a07bb4bf3e59375d93e
glfw-3.4.bin.WIN64.zip  54efa829400f2a0537f742b2b3bdd74e437bb4f2f048e4b7d3c5557d11a611e6
